say:4:1311206001:0.text: Finally, you're here! What took you so long? I was getting pretty anxious!
say:4:1311206001:0.source_cn: 你们总算找来了。真慢呀，我等得都着急了。

say:6:1311206003:0.text: I'll be waiting for you in the <style="highlight">great hall</style>...

say:11:1311206004:0.text: She said she would be waiting for us in the great hall!
say:11:1311206004:0.source_cn: 她刚才说“在谒见大厅等我们”！

say:12:1311206005:0.text: Check the map Ludovic gave us.
say:12:1311206005:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔给我们的地图里应该有标记城堡房间。

say:14:1311206006:0.source_cn: 找到了！谒见大厅……就是她离开的那个方向。

say:16:1311206007:0.text: What's up with this castle? It's so spooky and twisted, almost like it's pulled straight from one of Chippy's nightmares!
say:16:1311206007:0.source_cn: 城堡里到底怎么了？又诡异又扭曲，就像……对，就像满满没...

choice_prompt:17:1311206007.text: What's up with this castle? It's so spooky and twisted, almost like it's pulled straight from one of Chippy's nightmares!
choice_prompt:17:1311206007.source_cn: 城堡里到底怎么了？又诡异又扭曲，就像……对，就像满满没睡好的时候做的梦一样！

say:18:1311206008:0.text: This is not the Valesa Castle I envisioned. Ludovic once spoke of its marble floors and gilded interiors.
say:18:1311206008:0.source_cn: 瓦勒沙城堡内部不该是这种风格，我听柳博米尔描述过大理石...

say:19:1311206009:0.text: But what we see now is a far cry from his descriptions.
say:19:1311206009:0.source_cn: 现在我们眼前的……完全是另一种模样。

say:20:1311206010:0.source_cn: 看上去像是魔法造成的……

say:21:1311206013:0.text: We need to find Princess Yolena quickly and figure out what she's done!
say:21:1311206013:0.source_cn: 我们要快点找到亚莲娜公主，搞清楚她到底做了什么！

say:22:1311206014:0.text: We can't pass through here; let's find another way.
say:22:1311206014:0.source_cn: 通往谒见大厅的路断了，我们得想办法绕过去。

say:23:1311206015:0.text: The princess... no, that person was standing on a movable snowflake-shaped stone plate. I wonder if there are more of those plates we can find and use.
say:23:1311206015:0.source_cn: 刚才，公主……不，那个人站在一块可以移动的雪花形石板上...

say:28:1311206016:0.text: Aha! Over here, to the right!
say:28:1311206016:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们找找看！啊，看到了，在右边！

say:29:1311206017:0.text: <style="highlight">There's another stone plate to the right</style>! Uh... Magister, do you think it's safe for us to stand on it?
say:29:1311206017:0.male: <style="highlight">There's another stone plate to the right</style>! Uh... Magister, do you think it's safe for us to stand on it?
say:29:1311206017:0.female: <style="highlight">There's another stone plate to the right</style>! Uh... Magister, do you think it's safe for us to stand on it?

choice_prompt:30:1311206017.text: <style="highlight">There's another stone plate to the right</style>! Uh... Magister, do you think it's safe for us to stand on it?
choice_prompt:30:1311206017.source_cn: <style=highlight>右边还有一块移动石板</style>！呃……主人，我们站上去没问题吧？
choice_prompt:30:1311206017.male: <style="highlight">There's another stone plate to the right</style>! Uh... Magister, do you think it's safe for us to stand on it?
choice_prompt:30:1311206017.female: <style="highlight">There's another stone plate to the right</style>! Uh... Magister, do you think it's safe for us to stand on it?

say:31:1311206019:0.text: Let's see where this stone plate takes us.
say:31:1311206019:0.source_cn: 走吧，看看这块移动石板会带我们去哪里。

say:33:1311206018:0.text: Hm...? Magister, promise you'll come save Chippy if anything happens!
say:33:1311206018:0.source_cn: 啊？那……要是满满掉下去了，主人一定要把满满救上来才行！
say:33:1311206018:0.male: Hm...? Magister, promise you'll come save Chippy if anything happens!
say:33:1311206018:0.female: Hm...? Magister, promise you'll come save Chippy if anything happens!

choice:30:1:2.text: How about you try it first?
choice:30:1:2.male: How about you try it first?
choice:30:1:2.female: How about you try it first?

narration:34:13011221:0.text: Princess Yolena rides a strange snowflake platform and travels to the other side of the castle.
narration:34:13011221:0.source_cn: 亚莲娜公主搭上诡异的雪花平台，跨越虚空，前往了城堡的另一端。

choice:17:0:1.text: The style here is quite unique.
choice:17:0:1.male: The style here is quite unique.
choice:17:0:1.female: The style here is quite unique.

say:35:1311206011:0.text: I have this gnawing dread, a mix of sorrow and rage... It is as though I have once more stepped into the battlefield...
say:35:1311206011:0.source_cn: 我有种不好的感觉，痛苦和仇恨……就好像回到了当年的战场...

say:36:1311206012:0.text: There's something terrifying in this castle...
say:36:1311206012:0.source_cn: 这座城堡里有很恐怖的东西……

choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 这里完全被魔法影响了
